exposure: timing of cerclage removal after PPROM (early < 48 hours vs. delayed >= 48 hours)
outcome: composite neonatal outcome (sepsis, prematurity complications, death)
cohort: Singleton pregnancies with cerclage who experienced preterm prelabor rupture of membranes (PPROM) before 34 weeks gestation.
finding: Delaying cerclage removal after PPROM increases the rate of postpartum endometritis and prolongs latency to delivery by one week, without significantly affecting neonatal morbidity and mortality.
